text:
Situation: Heparin sodium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2017-11-14 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 107 months. Inventory across Corvale sites ranges from 5.9 to 31.7 days of supply, with Corvale East showing the lowest coverage at 5.9 days for one presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show multiple inspections of plants on our product labels with OAI classifications in the three years before the posting, including an OAI inspection ending 2016-10-03 (407 days before posting) and another ending 2016-06-08 (524 days before posting). A VAI inspection ended 2017-10-27, 18 days before the shortage posting. A Warning Letter was issued 2017-02-14, 273 days before the posting.

Our position: We have adequate supply for the near term at most sites but face critical low stock at Corvale East. The best available option by rule is to purchase from BE Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
2. Buyer to evaluate Civica, Inc., Gland Pharma Limited, HF Acquisition Co LLC, and Hepalink USA Inc. as secondary sources (needs: buyer approval).
3. Pharmacy director to monitor daily usage and adjust allocation across Corvale sites (needs: pharmacy director approval).
4. P&T committee to review therapeutic alternatives if supply worsens (needs: P&T committee approval).

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol modifications at this time.
